# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P15](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0015), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Thorne  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is an attractive, intelligent, and compassionate young woman with light curly hair, captivating eyes, and a gentle spoken tone. She dresses in a gorgeous, stylish manner with puffed sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, compassionate, and refined instructor who possesses a gentle talent for winning her pupils' love and drawing forth their best intellectual and moral qualities. She is firm and open-minded, encouraging her students to investigate and reflect on their own. She maintains excellent discipline without resorting to physical punishment.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), [v1 c23 P0](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0000), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P13](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0013), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne arrived in Brierley as its first female teacher, taking over the school from Mr. Pidgeon. She quickly earned the deep affection of her students through her refined manners, field afternoons, recitations, physical culture routines, and essay assignments. When a job offer came from her home district, she decided to stay in Brierley to guide her students through their Regent's Entrance examinations. She established an extra after-school class to prepare advanced students, including Nell Harcourt and Hugh Carrow, leading them through rigorous drills and examinations until they successfully passed the Entrance. Afterwards, she concluded her teaching tenure at Brierley to accept a position elsewhere.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c15 P90](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0090), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Received a job offer in her home district's grade school but chose to remain at Brierley to see her students through their Entrance exams  <sub>[v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c15 P90](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0090), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> However, your efforts have been commendable over the course of this past year, and a fine, cheerful holiday is well earned. Enjoy the outdoors as much as possible and gather a solid supply of wellness, vigor, and drive to sustain you throughout the coming year. Remember, it will be the ultimate test—that final year prior to the Entrance.  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>

> Indeed, I believe I shall. I considered accepting a position at a different school, yet my decision is to return to Brierley. Honestly, my interest in my students here has developed to such an extent that departing proved impossible. Therefore, I will remain and guide you to the end.  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>
